_comment_1: DevOps Agent on agentgate — template for ~/.claude/settings.json or .claude/settings.json
_comment_2: After install.sh, replace AGENTGATE_HOME with the absolute path to the agentgate repo on this machine.
_comment_3: After loading, restart Claude Code. New sessions will use this configuration.

mcpServers._comment_servers: Uncomment and configure any of the below as you adopt them. Each one wraps a real MCP server through agentgate's mcp-gate so destructive tool calls are intercepted and require approval.

_note: Claude Code does not yet have a stable settings key for default system prompts. Until then, paste the contents of system-prompt.md as the first message of new sessions, or symlink runbooks/ into your project root so Claude Code picks it up as project context.
